V9 WHAT THIS CANNOT SHOW
The towers use the promoter's motif profile, which is a 1 kb window of sequence.
Whether a factor is actually present at that promoter in K562 is not known here and
no expression or ChIP filter is applied.
AlphaFold geometry is an unbound monomer prediction. A DNA-binding domain changes
conformation on binding, and nothing here models that.
The proven subset is defined by statistical power, not by mechanism; a well-powered
negative is still only a negative for the effect size the screen could see.
Loop 178's element-intrinsic ceiling of 0.4422 and loop 181's 5 kb resolution limit
bound every number above, and no architecture in this loop addresses either.
